steps.message: a commons building needs ground no steeper than 5 percent

notes: The rule is on always, so a dig is checked against every commons. Digging tile 1,0 by 200 lowers vertices 1,0 and 1,1, the commons tile's NE and SE corners, to 1100 and 1000: tile 0,0 becomes NW 1300, NE 1100, SW 1200, SE 1000, triangle SW-SE-NE gradient (-200, 100) / 3048, 7.3362 percent, refused. Tile 2,0 shares no corner with tile 0,0, so digging it applies; vertices 2,0, 3,0 go to 1200 and 2,1, 3,1 to 1100, leaving the extremes at 900 and 1300.
